claim: FY2025 earnings report reveals AI networking revenue reached $850M, accelerating past original $750M milestone; 7060X6 800G shipments up 120% YoY
Ultra Ethernet Consortium (UEC) releases v1.0 specifications; Broadcom and Arista demonstrate interoperability across 16k GPU clusters
Nvidia launches Spectrum-X with unified NVLink scale-out pods; raises competitive friction for independent Ethernet switches in Tier-2 GPU clouds
SEC 10-K Customer concentration confirms top 2 hyperscalers represent 26% and 16% of total revenue (42% aggregate); capex digestion remains key tail risk

FY2025 10-K (filed 2026-02-17): revenue $9,005.7M (+28.6%; product $7,576.9M / service $1,428.8M); gross margin 64.1% (flat YoY); net income $3.5B; OCF $4.4B; RPO $6.1B with ~90% recognizable within 2 years [confirm pass 80%, sections s_0012_c09/s_0010_c04/s_0012_c43]

Q2 FY2026 10-Q + earnings call (2026-08-04): Q2 revenue $3,035.7M (+37.7% YoY, first $3B quarter); H1 op margin 44.1%; FY2026 guide raised 3x to $12.6B (+40%) with AI fabrics goal >=$3.5B and campus goal >=$1.25B; deferred revenue ~$6.9B (product deferrals +$600M QoQ on acceptance clauses); purchase commitments ~$9.7B (~3x YoY); diluted shares 1,276M; scale-across TAM $15-20B by 2030 [10-Q income statement; call transcript, primary]

FY2025 top-2 end customers at 16% and 26% = 42% combined, UP from 35% in FY2024 (10-K s_0003_c09, confirm pass 80%) — prediction anet-top2-cust-conc-fy25 resolved FALSE; diversification thesis not yet delivering. CEO expects 'one, maybe two' new 10% customers beyond Microsoft and Meta (Q2'26 call)

Prediction anet-ai-rev-fy25 resolved FALSE on review: Arista does not disclose AI revenue as a line item in SEC filings (verified via filings adapter over FY2025 10-K + FY2026 10-Q) — AI goals live in earnings calls/IR only. Prediction was mis-specified (disclosure behavior, not operations); superseded by anet-ai-fabrics-fy26 resolving against the $3.5B earnings-call goal

Driver-model pilot (WO-4c): ANET base scenario now carries a sourced four-driver FY2030 revenue build — AI fabrics $9.0B (TAM $45B x 20% share) + core DC/routing $9.4B ($6.2B FY26 base x 1.11^4) + campus $2.2B ($1.25B x 1.15^4) + service $2.9B ($1.43B x 1.15^5) = $23.5B, 39% net margin, 1,276M shares -> derived EPS $7.18 (~21% CAGR from FY2025 $2.74, above the scenario's 0.18 — held as documented upside, not promoted).
